processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: As-hot-rolled condition; specific hot-rolling temperature and reduction are not reported for this 2.7% Si plate (the 84% reduction at 900°C in the text applies to a 1% Si wrought plate).
Slow cooling after deformation is related to short-range ordering (SRO) and precipitation of κ-carbide in the as-hot-rolled material.

structures.overall_structure: Hot-rolled Fe-30Mn-9Al-2.7Si-0.9C steel with an average grain size of 50 µm; slow cooled after deformation with SRO and κ-carbide precipitation.

interfaces.slip_behavior: Planar-slip-related brittle fracture: {111} slip traces on cleavage facets; slip traces at roughly 60° angles from one another indicate fracture by decohesion of active slip planes.
interfaces.phase_evolution: Short-range ordering (SRO) and κ-carbide precipitation occurred because the hot-rolled material was slow cooled after deformation.

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Breaking energy 23 J in the L–T orientation and 22 J in the T–L orientation.

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: CVN breaking energy (L–T orientation): 23 J as-hot-rolled versus 160 J after solution treatment for 10 min at 1100°C and water quenching.

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: room temperature; L–T and T–L specimen orientations
characterization_methods.purpose: Measure room-temperature notch toughness (breaking energy) of the as-hot-rolled steel.
characterization_methods.key_findings: Breaking energy 23 J (L–T) and 22 J (T–L); fracture mainly transgranular cleavage-type with little evidence of ductility.

characterization_methods.purpose: Characterize the fracture mode of the as-hot-rolled CVN specimens.
characterization_methods.key_findings: Transgranular cleavage-type fracture with {111} slip traces on cleavage facets; slip traces at roughly 60° angles; little evidence of ductility.

unmapped_findings: Nominal composition: Fe-30Mn-9Al-2.7Si-0.9C with 0.023% P (chemistry values in weight percent) [b0059].
Room-temperature Charpy V-notch (CVN) breaking energy in the as-hot-rolled condition: 23 J in the L–T orientation and 22 J in the T–L orientation [b0059].
